name: Fish curry
description: Fish simmered briefly in a sour, spiced gravy — tamarind in the south, mustard in the east.

tcm.note: Fish with sour and pungent spicing.

ayurveda.note: Matsya is ushna and the souring agents add to it.

unani.note: Garam-tar; and famously never eaten with milk.

histamine.note: Depends heavily on the fish's freshness; the tamarind adds a liberator.
